explicit_counterexample: For i=1,...,7 in the natural A7 action, let H_i be the stabilizer of i. The seven proper subgroups H_i are distinct, each has index 7, and all pairwise index gcds are 7. Pick g_i in A7 with g_i(i)=1. Then g_i H_i={g in A7:g(i)=1}; these seven left cosets are pairwise disjoint and partition A7. This is a written construction, not yet independently replayed; the parent reports a disjoint review is assigned. It disproves the frozen candidate's unqualified seven-index exclusion even if distinct subgroups or seven disjoint cosets are demanded. It provides no eight-disjoint-coset Sun8 counterexample.
